hook: C.C. Wei leads the company that manufactures most of the world's advanced AI chips. He joined TSMC in 1998 after earlier engineering roles at Texas Instruments, ST Microelectronics, and Chartered Semiconductor, and spent the next quarter century rising through business development and operating roles before becoming President and Co-CEO in 2013, sole CEO in 2018, and Chairman and CEO in 2024. Under his leadership TSMC's advanced process nodes have become the manufacturing bottleneck and enabler for the generative AI buildout, supplying the chips behind most leading GPUs and AI accelerators. He holds a PhD in electrical engineering from Yale and has repeatedly told investors that AI-driven demand for TSMC's most advanced capacity remains structurally strong even as supply stays tight.
